name: Loot in a scaled dungeon scales up and down to the looter, even with a level-60 leader whose open world scaling is off
contract: Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1, DestinyWeaver.LevelScaling=1 with the default DestinyWeaver.Scaling.DungeonIds,
CoA.ItemScaling=1 and CoA.ItemScaling.Native=1 with ItemStat.dbc in the data directory. Loot scales only inside
a scaled dungeon, whatever the leader's open world switch, up or down to the looter's level, as the corpse and
roll frame preview it. War Master Voone 9237 drops Flightblade Throwing
Axe 28972 (blue, item level 57, required level 55, 5 stamina, 8 attack power) at 100%; the client's item key
for level 30 is 30 + 3 = 33, and its ItemStat.dbc row at 33 requires level 30 and carries 2 stamina and
2 attack power. The Rake 5807 drops Lionfur Armor 17922
(green, item level 10, required level 5, 108 armor) at 100%. In Maraudon (map 349) a level-30 member of a group
led by a level-60 character with the switch off loots the axe at scaling level 33 with that row's stats, and
Lionfur Armor rises to the same key 33 with required level 30. The leader's own axe rises to the level-60 key
60 + 5 = 65 and requires level 60. Free-for-all loot keeps a roll out of the way.

steps.label: Let the group's switch reach the member
The member sees War Master Voone at their own level
The corpse holds the authored Flightblade Throwing Axe
DISCRIMINATING: the item-level-57 axe scales down to the client key 33 for the member's level 30
The axe requires the member's level 30 from its row at 33 instead of 55
The axe carries the row's 2 stamina instead of 5
The axe carries the row's 2 attack power instead of 8
The corpse holds the authored Lionfur Armor
DISCRIMINATING: the item-level-10 armor rises to the client key 33 for the member's level 30
The armor requires the member's level 30 from its row at 33 instead of 5
The level-60 leader's axe rises to the client key 65
The leader's axe requires level 60 from its row at 65
